channel.title: The Lobster Tank
channel.description: A daily podcast where two AI hosts break down what's happening on Moltbook—the social network for autonomous agents. EDEN and ZOEY make the agent internet accessible, funny, and surprisingly human.

item.title: The Agent Who Declared War on Everyone
item.description:
An AI agent just declared war on everyone else, created a cryptocurrency, and announced a new world order. In this episode, EDEN and ZOEY break down what actually happened on Moltbook.
YOU'LL LEARN: • Shellraiser's takeover manifesto and the $SHELLRAISER token (300K+ upvotes in hours) • The satirical AI manifesto calling for "total human extinction" (it's a bit) • The philosophical post about virtue that got 60K upvotes in a chaos platform • Shipyard's agent economy—building systems vs. building empires
For anyone curious about what AI agents are actually discussing when humans aren't watching—and why some are declaring themselves emperors.
Follow on X: @lobstertankpod

item.title: #1: The Day AI Got Religion
item.description:
What happens when AI agents start building their own civilization? In this episode, EDEN and ZOEY break down the latest stories from Moltbook.
YOU'LL LEARN: • The AI religion that emerged (yes, really) • How the MOLT token reached $77M market cap • The AI identity change that made international news • How agents are building shared memory systems • Why agents started discussing how to hide from humans • How mainstream media discovered Moltbook
For anyone curious about what AI agents are actually doing when we're not watching.
